messages.author: a620c503c75fc861
messages.subject: how to create a new GUI
parts:
Hi,
I have read something about the extensibility of deducer with new GUI created by developers. I have created some functions in R language to perform array analysis and I like to create their GUI to insert in Deducer menu system. Could you suggest me something to do it?
Once it is done will there be any change in data viewer?

Thanks you in advance for your help.

Nico

messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: Re: how to create a new GUI
parts:
Hi,
 
Ian published a nice tutorial here:
http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/index.php?n=Main.Development
 
Following those instructions and examples is relatively easy, and the results are quite good.
Helios
